document.title: Foreign currency member pickup
document.purpose: Provide a consistent, secure process for handing over foreign currency orders.

when_to_use: A member arrives to collect a foreign currency order.

guidelines: Verify the member before releasing an order.

controls: Match identification to the order record.

roles_responsibilities.responsibility: Verify identity and record the collection.

procedures.title: Verify the member and order

steps.instruction: Ask the member for a valid photo ID.
Locate the order and match the member’s details.

decision_logic.content: If the member does not pick up within 30 days, use the Unclaimed Orders workflow.

exceptions: Contact the branch manager if verification cannot be completed.

procedures.title: Complete the pickup

steps.instruction: Count the currency with the member.
Record collection and provide a receipt.

decision_logic.if: The amount does not match the order
decision_logic.then: Pause and ask the branch manager to reconcile the difference.

warnings: Do not release currency until verification is complete.
procedures.expected_result: The order is collected and recorded.

migration_concerns.review_needed: Confirm the current unclaimed order policy before publishing.

other_information: Sample content only; adapt it to your organization’s policy.
